Game Overview

Pigeons Pigeons is a arcade title where become humanity's last hope against the ever-present pigeon menace. Arm yourself with a shotgun and take aim at 12 quirky pigeon types across 30 challenging levels. Experience unexpected twists and interactive destruction as you embark on this exhilarating, sky-clearing adventure. Are you ready to face the feathers?
